summary: The private preview accurately describes the single authenticated Texas count-model preparation packet. It keeps setup, execution/result, empirical evidence, and public-site availability as separate states. I found no material UI or metadata cross-binding issue in the reviewed snapshot.

scope.selection_mode: one linked required setup; roles are not independently selectable

review_findings.finding: Visible wording distinguishes a recorded preparation from a completed count forecast, empirical forecast accuracy, and public availability. It says the catalog cannot schedule a calculation and does not imply current job activity.
evidence: The UI has separate Recorded setup, Calculation results, Testing & evidence, and Site availability cards.
The eight roles are presented as one linked setup, and the page has no selection, run, save, chart, or fetch controls.
The stale/unavailable path renders a validation failure message instead of inventing model components or results.

review_findings.finding: The native scope and preparation hashes are bound into the staged metadata. Server validation and the offline importer verify the recorded native links and source plan/problem scope; the browser DTO is path-free and the browser parser remains structural validation rather than an authentication boundary.
evidence: Root metadata verification reports passed_metadata_only and native_bytes_preserved=true.
The staged six-file set has pinned raw-byte hashes and the source plan/problem are checked without being copied into the runtime stage.

limitations: This packet records one Texas fixed-roster conditional setup for the regular 2026 contest, with 2020 and 2024 as specified earlier elections. It is not a general role-selection catalog; another setup requires a new authenticated native catalog/resolution.
The preparation status is requires_computation. No completed count forecast, current execution/liveness result, registered count result, or empirical accuracy evaluation is supplied by this packet.

The reviewed scope authenticates the listed metadata and plan/problem relation. It does not claim independent revalidation of the complete transitive runtime/source closure or scientific quality of a future result.
The preview is not connected to a production route. This review does not establish a public release, and no user-configuration storage was added.

independent_test_result.note: The three skipped cases require opt-in importer/browser environment variables; those paths have separate pinned author evidence.

checks: No horizontal overflow at mobile or desktop viewport
No input, select, button, SVG, or canvas elements

verification.typecheck: Full TypeScript check passed after parser narrowing fixes.
verification.production_build: Root reports production build passed. The catalog remains a private preview with no public route added.
verification.metadata_import: Root metadata verification reports passed_metadata_only; no model fit or scientific job was started.
